payload.title: install --plugin is ignored by the cratylus command
payload.body: Observed on unit/consumer-path b5735e03: cratylus install --plugin nonexistent-pkg --all --dry-run succeeds and installs the bundled corpus. install() in packages/forge/src/cli/commands/install.ts takes opts.corpus before opts.plugin, and packages/forge/src/cli/index.ts always passes corpus: options.defaultCorpus, so the flag the help describes as 'The corpus package to install' never takes effect from the cratylus command. packages/cli/README.md states what the code does (the flag row says the bundled corpus is installed whatever it names; a cratylus.config.ts is what installs another). Ruling owed: make the flag work, or remove it from install and its help.
